You are active on the online forums for The Ghost Bro Mystery Show, a TV program about a group of young men and women, the Ghost Bros, who investigate haunted places in North America. When you post a question about a Deep Lake mystery on the forums, roll with Presence.

  • [ON 10+] a commenter has a good answer or a Clue (Keeper’s choice), and they’ll share it freely.

  • [ON 7-9] as above, but they want you to do something for them before they’ll share it.
